'''Barquin D'an''' was a [[Bith]] who worked as a professional [[musician]] and was the younger [[Gender|brother]] of fellow musician [[Figrin D'an]]. After visiting the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of the [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], Barquin ended up playing [[kloo horn]] in the [[Max Rebo Band]], house band for Jabba. In [[3 ABY]], the band performed for the crime lord aboard his [[sail barge]], ''[[Khetanna]]''.

In [[4 ABY]], Barquin and the band performed for Jabba and his court in the palace's throne room. While they played ''[[Jedi Rocks]]'', Jabba interupted the [[music]] by dropping the [[Slavery|enslaved]] dancer [[Oola]] into a pit below the throne room, where she was [[Death|eaten]] by the [[rancor]] [[Pateesa]]. Barquin was then still present in the throne room when [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] arrived disguised as the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boushh]] in order to present the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] to Jabba. The next [[Standard day|day]], Organa and her allies killed Jabba, and a delighted Barquin fled to [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]]

==Biography==
===Stumbling into a bad deal===
Hailing from the [[planet]] [[Bith (planet)|Bith]],<ref name="Geektionary French" /> Barquin D'an was a [[Bith]] [[Gender|male]] who was the younger brother of [[Figrin D'an]], leader of the band [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]]. Barquin also worked as<ref name="Lando" /> a professional [[musician]]<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> and, after Figrin ironically caused the [[death]] of [[Evar Orbus]], Barquin visited the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]'s [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] looking for work. Barquin then stumbled into playing the [[kloo horn]] in the [[Max Rebo Band]], the Hutt's house band, who were practically [[Slavery|enslaved]] by Jabba due to a contract signed by the band's leader, [[Maximilian Rebo|Max Rebo]].<ref name="Lando" />

[[File:ReboBandKhetanna-WOTBHAlpha1.png|thumb|right|300px|Barquin D'an played in Jabba Desilijic Tiure's house band.]]
In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="WarDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[War of the Bounty Hunters Alpha 1|''War of the Bounty Hunters Alpha'' 1]] to [[3 ABY]].</ref> Barquin and the rest of the Max Rebo Band were playing on the ''[[Khetanna]]'', Jabba's personal [[sail barge]], when the Hutt's [[majordomo]], [[Bib Fortuna]], contacted the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] for an update on [[Han Solo]], a [[smuggler]] who had been frozen in [[carbonite]] that Fett was delivering to the Hutt.<ref name="War">[[War of the Bounty Hunters Alpha 1|''War of the Bounty Hunters Alpha'' 1]]</ref> Fett eventually did deliver the smuggler to Jabba's Palace, where Solo was hung on a wall in the throne room as a trophy. Solo's allies in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], including [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]], then began planning to [[Rescue of Han Solo|rescue]] Solo.<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref>

===''Jedi Rocks'', interrupted===
In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> the rebels initiated their plan, having Solo's friend [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] infiltrate the palace as a guard and sending the [[droid]]s [[R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO]] to Jabba as a gift. Shortly after the droids arrived, Barquin and the rest of the Max Rebo Band put on a performance for Jabba and his [[Jabba's criminal empire|court]] in the throne room,<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> playing a relatively slow tune while the [[Slavery|enslaved]] dancers [[Oola]] and [[Yarna d'al' Gargan]] performed before the Hutt. Once the song ended, Jabba ordered Oola to repeat her performance, but thinking that the Hutt was giving orders to the band, the singer [[Joh Yowza]] shouted for them to start playing again.<ref name="RotJ novel">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]]</ref>

[[File:DodaBodonawieedoBarquinDan-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|300px|Barquin D'an and Doda Bodonawieedo playing ''Jedi Rocks'']]
After stopping the<ref name="RotJ novel" /> [[Growdi Harmonique]] player<ref name="Lando" /> [[Rappertunie]] from starting a different song, Yowza had the band play<ref name="RotJ novel">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]]</ref> "[[Jedi Rocks]]."<ref name="JediRocks">{{SW|url=news/music-in-the-star-wars-galaxy-the-modal-nodes-vs-the-max-rebo-band|text=Music in the ''Star Wars'' Galaxy: The Modal Nodes vs. The Max Rebo Band|int=Music in the Star Wars Galaxy: The Modal Nodes vs. The Max Rebo Band}}</ref> Leaning back as he blew into the kloo horn, Barquin stood beside<ref name="ROTJ" /> the [[Rodian]] bandmember [[Doda Bodonawieedo]]<ref name="Lando" /> as the song went on, although the performance was abruptly interrupted when Jabba dropped Oola through a trap door after the dancer refused his advances. With the [[music]] ended, other members of the court rushed forward to watch through a grate in the floor as Oola was [[Death|devoured]] by Jabba's pet [[rancor]],<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Pateesa]],<ref name="LD">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref> in a pit below the throne room.<ref name="ROTJ" />

===Fatalities and freedom===
Once the excitement was over,<ref name="ROTJ" /> Barquin was still present in the throne room<ref name="Geektionary" /> when Organa arrived in disguise as the bounty hunter<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Boushh]],<ref name="Geektionary" /> dragging her supposed [[prisoner]] Chewbacca with her. During negotiations over a [[bounty]] that Jabba had placed on Chewbacca, Organa activated a [[thermal detonator]], terrifying Rebo and many other members of the court. Jabba merely laughed, and offered "Boushh" an improved price, which Organa accepted. Chewbacca was dragged away and the court then celebrated his capture.<ref name="ROTJ" />

[[File:Barquin-IAmADroid.png|thumb|right|300px|Barquin D'an did not enjoy playing for Jabba.]]
The next [[Standard day|day]], Jabba ordered the executions of Chewbacca, a recently unfrozen Solo, and their newly arrived ally, [[Luke Skywalker]]. The Hutt and much of his court, including some members of the band, then traveled on the ''Khetanna'' to watch the executions at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]]; however, the rebels freed themselves and killed Jabba and many of his allies at the pit.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Following the Hutt's death, the band was freed and Barquin made his escape to [[Mos Eisley]],<ref name="Lando" /> a [[spaceport]] on Tatooine.

==Personality and traits==
Barquin D'an did not enjoy playing the kloo horn for Jabba and was delighted to make his escape after the Hutt's death. D'an had [[Color|pink]] skin and black [[eye]]s.<ref name="Lando" />

==Equipment==
While working for Jabba, Barquin wore a black [[Clothing|shirt]], black pants, and black shoes. The Bith played a kloo horn in the Max Rebo Band.<ref name="Lando" />

==Behind the scenes==
Barquin D'an was portrayed by creature and model maker [[Don Bies]] in the [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]] re-release of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]<ref name="BuildR2">{{BuildR2Cite|97|Building the Galaxy}}</ref> on [[March 14]], [[1997]].<ref name="YbY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> Director [[Richard Marquand]], the puppet team at [[Industrial Light & Magic]], and producer [[George Lucas]] had wanted to shoot a larger musical number in the original release of Episode VI, but lacked the budget, and so Lucas added an extended replacement sequence for the ''Jedi Rocks'' performance in the re-release. Concept art for the "Jabba Rocks" musical number drawn by concept artist [[Terryl Whitlatch]] on [[January 23]], [[1996]], showed a new Bith member of the Max Rebo Band labeled as "Figrin D'an," with the piece earning a "Fabulouso" stamp from Lucas. The number was shot on a reproduction of about one quarter of the original Jabba's throne room set on a Industrial Light & Magic stage.<ref name="Archives">''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005]]''</ref>

The character's mask and costume were designed from the costumes used for the Modal Nodes in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|barquindan|D'an, Barquin}}</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was first identified in ''[[Music in the Star Wars Galaxy: The Modal Nodes vs. The Max Rebo Band]]'', a [[StarWars.com]] article written by [[Amy Ratcliffe]] and published on [[February 24]], [[2015]].<ref name="Music">{{SW|url=news/music-in-the-star-wars-galaxy-the-modal-nodes-vs-the-max-rebo-band|text=Music in the ''Star Wars'' Galaxy: The Modal Nodes vs. The Max Rebo Band|int=Music in the Star Wars Galaxy: The Modal Nodes vs. The Max Rebo Band}}</ref> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where the [[Barquin D'an/Legends|character]] was first identified as Barquin D'an in ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', a supplement for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[West End Games]]<ref name="Trilogy">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref> in [[October]], 1997.<ref name="SWGC1">{{CollectorCite|1|Playing A Major Role}}</ref>
